description: The one Honeycrisp window. Rust opens it on Honeycrisp's AppData root alone, whose settings.md the page reads (openDevice from @epicenter/folder/tauri); the page then asks for its data folder (open_data_folder: the folder settings.md names, or ~/Epicenter/Honeycrisp), which Rust admits, makes the window's watched root with the AppData root granted beside it, or refuses with why. It may pick another data folder (choose_data_folder, a native picker). The folder plugin refuses any other root. On close it waits for queued writes, then destroys the window. Through the folder plugin it may ask Epicenter to sync the data folder (epicenter://init) and whether Epicenter already does.
